issues.subject: Built In profile access blocked during pages 5-7 retry
issues.details: Profiles were opened one at a time with a five-second pause between requests. Wells Fargo was confirmed with an HQ in San Francisco and a direct View Website link. Sendbird listed HQ San Mateo and Attain listed HQ Chicago; neither profile exposed a San Francisco office in the retrieved overview, so neither was included. The fourth profile (Crunchyroll) displayed a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge. Per the collection procedure, no request was retried or bypassed; the remaining page-5 profiles and pages 6-7 were left unprocessed.
